data.body: Box check during a real review: PASS. 2026-11-23 04:22:53 PST, read-only counts-only SSM run of realcheck/box_ps_check.sh (params.json identical to the script, 19 lines) on i-00880b2c7f13527c5, SSM command 94711cb8-d5e9-4694-baab-ceb1bef6328a, started 3 s before pushing Gerrit changes 3533 and 3534, which the review-bot then fetched. Output: bot-deployed-sha=053604a2618d56bc23cffa99bba3a497b10b28b0, deployed_gerrit_git_env_defs=3, samples=571 gerrit_fetch_lines_seen=16 userinfo_lines=0 auth_header_lines=0.
